sn55.42:1.3: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti
sn55.42:1.4: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn55.42:3.1: vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati muttacāgo payatapāṇī vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato.
sn55.42:3.3: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puññābhisandā kusalābhisandā sukhassāhārā.
sn55.42:4.1: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi puññābhisandehi kusalābhisandehi samannāgatassa ariyasāvakassa na sukaraṃ puññassa pamāṇaṃ gaṇetuṃ
sn55.42:4.3: atha kho asaṅkheyyo appameyyo mahāpuññakkhandhotveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn55.42:5.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave yatthimā mahānadiyo saṃsandanti samenti. seyyathīdaṃ.
sn55.42:5.2: gaṅgā yamunā aciravatī sarabhū mahī tattha na sukaraṃ udakassa pamāṇaṃ gaṇetuṃ
sn55.42:5.3: ettakāni udakāḷhakāni iti vā ettakāni udakāḷhakasatāni iti vā ettakāni udakāḷhakasahassāni iti vā ettakāni udakāḷhakasatasahassāni iti vāti
sn55.42:5.4: atha kho asaṅkheyyo appameyyo mahāudakakkhandhotveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn55.42:5.5: evameva kho bhikkhave imehi catūhi puññābhisandehi kusalābhisandehi samannāgatassa ariyasāvakassa na sukaraṃ puññassa pamāṇaṃ gaṇetuṃ
sn55.42:5.7: atha kho asaṅkheyyo appameyyo mahāpuññakkhandhotveva saṅkhaṃ gacchatīti.
